about.title: About me
about.text1: Hey there, I'm Anika! Not long ago, coding was a completely foreign world to me – today, I’m building interactive web applications and crafting modern frontend projects in an intensive coding bootcamp. As a career changer, I’ve turned my initial curiosity into a genuine passion and a relentless thirst for knowledge. I’m not satisfied with just 'good enough' – every project is an opportunity to push my limits, refine my code, and craft clean, intuitive interfaces.
about.text2: Let's connect and create something amazing together!

skills.title: Core Competencies
skills.text: My skillset is rooted in hands-on frontend development. From interactive applications and dynamic API integrations to structured layouts and complex features, I build responsive, user-centric web applications with a strong emphasis on clean UI and smooth experiences.
skills.title2: Don't see the skill you are looking for?
skills.text2: Feel free to reach out! I pick up new technologies quickly and I’m always keen to learn. Currently, I’m especially curious about:

projects.title: My Work
projects.text: Here's a selection of projects I've built — feel free to interact with them and see my skills in action.

items.description: Jump, run and throw — El Pollo Loco was my first dive into object-oriented JavaScript. Help Pepe collect coins and tabasco bottles to take down the crazy hen.

Manage tasks, coordinate teams, keep projects on track — Join brings all your project management into one clear Kanban board. Create tasks, assign them to contacts, and stay on top of every step in your workflow.

reference.title: What my colleagues say about me

items.name: Anastasia Roberz
items.ref: Anika combined strong project organization with fast, thorough code reviews that kept our workflow moving smoothly. Her keen eye for detail and clean, responsive implementation were key to delivering a polished UI and a well-thought-out UX across the board.

items.name: Hermann Ejrich
items.ref: Anika has a strong sense of quality and always keeps the end user in mind, including people who depend on assistive technology. She caught issues that had gone unnoticed, fixed them on her own initiative and invited feedback from the team. She is a thoughtful and careful developer.

contact.title: Let's build something Cool together!
contact.subtitle: Got a problem to solve?
contact.text: Whether it’s a new project, a frontend role, or just a quick question — I’m happy to hear from you. I’m looking for a team where I can grow, contribute, and build things worth showing off. Sound like a fit? Drop me a message!
